events.label: outpost_established
events.text: North-West Mounted Police camp set up at Writing-on-Stone to curb smuggling.

events.label: outpost_closed
events.text: NWMP outpost at Writing-on-Stone was closed.

events.label: outpost_destroyed
events.text: Outpost fell victim to arson by unknown persons shortly after closure.

evidence.quote: shortly thereafter , the outpost fell victim to arson by persons unknown
The original outpost was burned down by persons unknown

events.text: Reconstruction of the NWMP outpost began, for the NWMP centennial.

evidence.quote: the outpost was reconstructed between 1973 and 1975

events.label: archaeological_survey
events.text: Alberta Provincial Parks archaeologists surveyed and catalogued rock art sites.

evidence.quote: surveyed and catalogued numerous petroglyph and pictograph sites within the park in 1973

events.text: Reconstruction of the NWMP outpost was completed.

evidence.quote: the outpost was reconstructed between 1973 and 1975

events.label: designation
events.text: Park designated an archaeological preserve, protecting pictographs and petroglyphs.

evidence.quote: was designated an archaeological preserve in 1977
In 1977 , the park preserved the archaeology of the pictographs and petroglyphs

events.label: designation
events.text: Portion of the park named a Provincial Historic Resource to protect rock art.

evidence.quote: In 1981 , a portion of the park was named a Provincial Historic Resource

events.label: heritage_nomination
events.text: Parks Canada added the park to Canada's tentative list of World Heritage sites.

evidence.quote: In 2004 Parks Canada added the park to Canadas tentative list of possible world heritage sites

events.label: designation
events.text: Park designated a National Historic Site.

evidence.quote: In March 2005 , the park was designated a National Historic Site

events.text: New visitor centre with valley views officially opened.

evidence.quote: the parks new visitor centre , with views of the valley from the north rim , was officially opened

events.label: heritage_inscription
events.text: Writing-on-Stone / Áísínai'pi inscribed as a UNESCO World Heritage Site.

evidence.quote: On 6 July 2019 , Writing-on-Stone / Áísínai’pi was inscribed as a UNESCO World Heritage Site
